Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate strict offline signing and authenticated encrypted package handoff
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: c436ceb0f990592f64e4f4c71e696a3dfb4e570e
Scope: Windows x64 restore, self-contained app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, offline signer positive/negative tests, RSA-OAEP/AES-256-GCM package encryption/decryption round trip, tampered ciphertext rejection, and updater transaction tests.
Security: CI uses throwaway ephemeral keys only. The owner package-encryption key files are not yet present, so the optional encrypted artifact upload must remain skipped. No plaintext package, production key, private source, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded.
